sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.13 "EXTI external interrupt selection register (EXTI_EXTICR1)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 461.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
EXTI mux 0, 1, 2, 3
Bits 31:24 EXTI3[7:0]: EXTI3 GPIO port selection
These bits are written by software to select the source input for EXTI3 external interrupt.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV3 is disabled, EXTI3 can be accessed with privileged and
unprivileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV3 is enabled, EXTI3 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this bit is discarded.
